name: Biomass gasification to hydrogen
principle: Biomass is gasified, the syngas is cleaned and shifted, and hydrogen is separated. NREL's independent review modelled a first plant of 500 dry t/day and an nth plant of 2,000 dry t/day. IEA lists biomass-waste gasification without CCUS at TRL 6 and with CCUS at TRL 5.

performance.metric: hydrogen yield per dry tonne of biomass
performance.basis: NREL review: first plant 72, nth plant 75

source.note: DOE EERE, Hydrogen production cost estimate using biomass gasification: independent review (NREL/BK-6A10-51726, October 2011; 2009 dollars)
